perks.name: Repulsor Brace

perks.name: Grave Robber

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.desc: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Classy Contender
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant class ability energy.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 18 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4NmtGbfgA5USVGjtqEcqps?si=17c11135a8cb4f39) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor add groups in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content, particularly with void builds. The Title returns for 2025 having lost Attrition Orbs as a trait perk but gaining a few other tricks. At base, the stats are decent by comparison with its peers - 40 Range and 15 Zoom equate to 18.06m ADS and 12.90m hipfire, 20 Stability is ×1.1000 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 48 Handling is 0.36s ready, 0.27s ADS and 0.33s stow speed, 23 Reload Speed is a 2.22s reload, Recoil Direction is 85, and base magazine size is 32 (max 39). Aggressives could to with a bit more Stability (Controller) or Handling (M+KB), or both from your barrel perk, and then any of the combat effect magazine perks work well on a bullet hose, or look to improve Reload Speed. For void builds, you have the option of Repulsor Brace for a void overshield on void-debuffed kills, and to provide those debuffs there's either Destabilizing Rounds to spread AoE volatility and proc Volatile Rounds or alternatively (maybe more difficult to proc on an SMG) Demoralize to spread AoE weaken on crit kills. Classy Contender is an unspectacular origin trait, generating roughly 5% class ability energy on kills, or situationally, Hakke Breach Armaments boosts damage against vehicles (×1.15), constructs (×1.3) and Stasis crystals (1.45). Recommended MW: Handling with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "The Title is one of my favorite sleeper weapons. I come back to it from time to time and it just feels good. There's just other options that pull me away. This version of the Title leans really hard into Void verbiage and wants to be glued to Void subclasses. Destabilizing Rounds, Demoralize, Repulsor Brace. The only thing it's missing from this to be the perfect Void weapon is Withering Gaze to finish the four piece." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "If The Title had better stability it would be an easier recommendation in PvP. It has decent stability compared to most of the other Aggressive Frame submachine guns. But it's just not good enough. Threat Detector helps when in close proximity, which, let's face it - you will be. Perpetual Motion also helps if you're constantly on the go. Swashbuckler is the best perk for going on sprees" Recommended MW: Stability.
pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload Speed.
pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Stability.
pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Range.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Void mains rejoice. I don’t think anyone is surprised to see this pick. Smallbore plus ricochet rounds boosts your stability and range enough to not worry about engagement ranges and compete with auto rifles. The extra overshield and add clearing capabilities will also allow you to allocate different fragments into your builds." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Swashbuckler is really the only standout perk in the fourth column. Some more niche options exist but there’s also not really a big pull to use this year's version of the Title for PvP. Rangefinder does help push out your zoom but with the recent changes to rangefinder it’s less than stellar." Recommended MW: Range (M+KB) / Stability (Controller).

SirStallion (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Pugilist / Swash is going to have a lot of fun potential on my void Titan, and that makes the combo worth hunting for. Titans can already get plenty of overshields, and being able to keep a steady flow of disc throws in is always a good time. I want both rolls, and I won't apologise for it. Gonna melee the world." Recommended MW: Reload.

SirStallion (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Cards on the table, I picked rangefinder because it was the best "neutral" perk in that 4th column, but it can absolutely be any other perk there you want. The rest of the roll is all about making your weapon a stat monster for 1v1s. I like 720s for 3v3 gamemodes, I think they're fun as heck. So giving my weapon a stat package that would make Banshee blush is always my goal. With 85 base Recoil Direction, the bonus handling and stability felt like a no brainer for me, Perp Motion is gonna bump that stab even further and anything else is just icing on the cake." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 98 from 19 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0cxvW6vTZVWtwmXkqr7g1f?si=66932432408046d2) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. The Title has decent stats in a crowded and competitive subfamily, including vertical recoil of 85 and 15 zoom, where 14 is the norm. Use the barrel perk to boost handling and/or stability, and the the combat effect magazine perks all have a place, or just look to boost reload speed with Alloy Mag or Flared Magwell. If you're looking for a workhorse void SMG, Threat Detector or Perpetual Motion in the first trait column to round out stats and boost reload, combined with Collective Action or Surrounded in the second for a solid damage boost will serve you well. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Hakke Breach Armaments adds damage to vehicles and constructs, but that's probably not as useful here. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 98 from 19 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0cxvW6vTZVWtwmXkqr7g1f?si=66932432408046d2) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content, particularly for Gyrfalcon Hunters. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. The Title has decent stats in a crowded and competitive subfamily, including vertical recoil of 85 and 15 zoom, where 14 is the norm. Use the barrel perk to boost handling and/or stability, and the the combat effect magazine perks all have a place, or just look to boost reload speed with Alloy Mag or Flared Magwell. Gyrfalcon void Hunters can already apply volatile rounds at will so kills to proc Repulsor Brace in the first trait column will be easy - but be aware this overrides the Void reserve Shield so you don't get the boost to class ability regeneration - but you do get the origin trait boost instead. In CQC you'll probably find the Overshield damage reduction really useful anyway, especially when paired with void fragments like Echo of Persistence. With the second column, as you don't need Destabilizing Rounds, Surrounded is a great passive boost to damage - up to 47% when you're able to enhance the perk. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful in the play loop to get your dodge back faster - Hakke Breach Armaments adds damage to vehicles and constructs, but that's probably not as useful here. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Submachine guns are the perfect run and gun weapon. They have better range than a sidearm, and feel better for a more run-and-gun play style than an auto rifle. Surrounded is the best damage perk for running into a group of enemies, and threat detector just enhances stats. Nothing like immediate damage." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "The Title doesn't need much to be a powerhouse in this meta. Rangefinder on a 750 is enough. But allowing you to duel multiple enemies within quick succession is another thing entirely. Without offering damage in the way of Kill Clip, the Title does give you Offhand Strike to take on multiple opponents while keeping your strafe speed up. Pairing this with a freehand grip would be my recommendation." Recommended MW: Range.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "This is the best version of the title we have seen. This almost competes with the like of Shayura's Tarrabah, IKELOS and Immortal. No adept mods, not the best range, but having rangefinder is an incredible bonus. Dynamic Sway Reduction is icing on the Title's cake for allowing a smooth shooting experience." Recommended MW: Stability.

SirStallion_ (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "For me personally, I like to full send into one particular element, Void Subclass with Void Weapons, making the most of the keywords from the subclass. As such, I don't value Pugilist for void. I just don't like the melee abilities for the most part and that's okay. [...] I do wish Repulsor was a column 3 perk, but I understand why it isn't. All that combined with Classy Contender will make this weapon a mainstay on my Gyrfalcon hunter or Devourlock once Volatile Flow is no longer on our artifact." Recommended MW: Stability.

SirStallion_ (PvP / M+KB): "Now you might be thinking "Stal, you put Arrowhead on all 3 rolls and haven't mentioned it. WHY. The gun has 85 RD, it doesn't need +30, +10 is enough if you absolutely want more, or you can use counterbalance." That's all true, but those don't also give +10 handling. That's only 5 less than Fluted, and I want my SMGs snappy. So if I can get more handling and a perfect 100 RD, I'm taking that every time." Recommended MW: Range.

SirStallion_ (PvP / Controller): "I don't like Rangefinder. [...] BUT there's no denying that people like it, and they should. So it's very easily swapped in, in place of Vorpal. Now then, why Vorpal? Well, it just feels like the best of the bunch for passive PvP usage. More damage on supers good. As for Flared Magwell over Ricochet or Hi-Cal, I like my stability bumped up when possible and there's nothing worse than being caught mid reload on something as heavy as a 750. Loader mods will help, but Flared is worth the investment for me." Recommended MW: Stability.

Sneecher (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "This year my Titan is going to lean heavily into Repulsor Brace. I am one of the few that enjoys the shield throw in PVE, and this combo will ensure that I always have one ready. Endless shield throws and volatile enemies guarantee that my Titan can rest easy knowing he will always have an overshield to protect him." Recommended MW: Stability.

Sneecher (PvP / M+KB): "For those hoping for/dreading an energy slot version of The Immortal, Target Lock is nowhere to be found. Despite that, the gun still has the same strong combo of Dynamic Sway and Rangefinder. Perpetual Motion is also a great choice for people who prefer that. I don’t love Threat Detector on aggressive frame SMGs, since the base ADS range is outside of Threat Detector’s activation range, but if you love it, go nuts." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 61 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/35xKd0TwFvvOyymsE9Wp5H) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for minor add clear in endgame activities. Unfortunately, this doesn't have great stats or any unique perk options by comparison with other aggressive frame SMGs, but drops will rain down during Guardian Games, so that's not unexpected (maybe it's just Hakke's unfamiliarity with energy weapons 😉). Season 20 has lost the S-Tier Stats/One for All combination, unfortunately. If you want to tuck one away, push out the range with your barrel and magazine, even at the cost of stability or handling, as we'll be getting that back with the traits, and the Recoil Direction of 85 is pretty much vertical. Full Bore and Ricochet Rounds add a few metres of useful range. In the first trait column as your support perk, if you're not proccing Threat Detector's bonus Stability, Handling and Reload Speed, you're just doing it wrong. Similarly with Surrounded as your second column signature perk - although it's not the Enhanced version, you'll still have 40% bonus damage when procced in CQC. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Or, if you're up against vehicles and constructs, Hakke Breach Armaments will help burst them down. Recommended MW: Range, Stability or Handling - just go with your preference, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod
